tangenaRabe.name: Tangena Rabe
tangenaRabe.description: Captain Tangena Rabe is the Fara's deadliest weapon against their sworn enemy, the Sea People. She has appeared in Fara territory, helming a formidable warship.

jokaKubwa.name: Joka Kubwa
jokaKubwa.description: Joka Kubwa, a zealous Ungwanan officer, seeks to scour the coast of all outside influence, be it French or pirate. His ship now prowls Ungwana-controlled waters.

ahPak.name: Ah Pak
ahPak.description: The Eels corsair known as Ah Pak has arrived in the Open Seas to establish himself as the Kingpin of Kingpins. Show him who truly rules the waves.

galvinRoche.name: Galvin Roche
galvinRoche.description: Captain Galvin Roche is on a drunken spree of murder and mayhem against the Ungwana. Sober him up with cannon-fire and reap the rewards.

dirkAnkeren.name: Dirk Ankeren
dirkAnkeren.description: Incensed by reports of rebel activity, the DMC has sent Dirk Ankeren, a brutal enforcer, to stake their claim. His ship will soon arrive in DMC waters.

dianSinaga.name: Dian Sinaga
dianSinaga.description: The Rempah have discovered that one of their own, Captain Dian Sinaga, is about to offer up vital secrets to the DMC for coin. She will soon appear in Rempah territory.

jonasVanderkill.name: Jonas Vanderkill
jonasVanderkill.description: Vanderkilrs DMC forces have been sighted nearby, and are due to arrive in the region, seeking a way to get to the Schaduw.

theOpwelling.name: The Opwelling
theOpwelling.description: Rising tensions in the Open Seas have forced the DMC to deploy their flagship to the region. The ship has begun patrolling the East Indies.

commanderZhang.name: Commander Zhang
commanderZhang.description: Sink Commander Zhang, the leader of the Dragon's Claw, and claim the spoils of war

abyssalEnvoy.name: Abyssal Envoy
abyssalEnvoy.description: A ghostly dread that whispers ruin emerges from the splintering tides. A cursed envoy of horrors to come.

bertrandHubac.name: Bertrand Hubac
bertrandHubac.description: The Compagnie has dispatched Bertrand of the Hubac Twins to reaffirm their supremacy in the Indian Ocean. Cunning and deadly, Bertrand is known for striking hard from afar.

vikramRajan.name: Vikram Rajan (Dangerous)
vikramRajan.description: Domain of Vikram Rajan. Use Rebellious Signal at this location to bring forth The Great Shadow.

liTianNing.name: Li Tian Ning (Dangerous)
liTianNing.description: Domain of Li Tian Ning. Use Rebellious Signal at this location to bring forth the Sky Goddess.

theHubacTwins.name: The Hubac Twins (Dangerous)
theHubacTwins.description: Domain of the Hubac Twins. Use Rebellious Signal at this location to bring forth Armand and Bertrand.

philippeLaPeste.name: Philippe La Peste (Dangerous)
philippeLaPeste.description: Domain of Philippe La Peste. Use Rebellious Signal at this location to bring forth the Plague King.

rodeMaangodin.name: Rode Maangodin
rodeMaangodin.description: Domain of the Rode Maangodin. Use Essence of Spirits at this location to bring forth the spectral ship.

zamaaribu.name: Zamaharibu
zamaaribu.description: Domain of Zamaharibu. Use Monstrous Bait at this location to bring forth the beast.

sadowbeast.name: Shadowbeast
sadowbeast.description: Domain of the Shadowbeast. Use Monstrous Bait at this location to bring forth the beast.

megaLestari.name: Mega Lestari
megaLestari.description: Domain of Mega Lestari. Use Monstrous Bait at this location to bring forth the beast.

heralosOfTheAbyss.name: Heralds of the Abyss
heralosOfTheAbyss.description: Shadows from beyond lurk at the edge of reality. Draw forth the Abyssal Fleet and banish them from this realm.

philppeLaPesteDeadlw.name: Philippe La Peste (Deadly)
philppeLaPesteDeadlw.description: Join 5 other captains to challenge La Peste at the height of his power.

difficulty.description: Join 5 other captains to challenge La Peste at the height of his power.

vikramRajanDeadlw.name: Vikram Rajan (Deadly)
vikramRajanDeadlw.description: Join 5 other captains to challenge Vikram at theheight of his power.

difficulty.description: Join 5 other captains to challenge Vikram at the height of his power.

kraken.name: Kraken
kraken.description: A shadow has been spotted lurking in the waters below, a prowling threat from the depths...

dominionOfRempahConvoy-route-1-variant-1.name: Underway
dominionOfRempahConvoy-route-1-variant-1.description: The chaos caused by the Compagnie has given the Rempah an opportunity to move their goods to their allies. They have set sail from Kencur, heading east with stylishly-crafted trade goods.

dominionOfRempahConvoy-route-1-variant-2.name: Departing Soon
dominionOfRempahConvoy-route-1-variant-2.description: The chaos caused by the Compagnie has given the Rempah an opportunity to move their goods to their allies. They will soon set sail from Kencur, heading east with stylishly-crafted trade goods.

dominionOfRempahConvoy-route-2-variant-1.name: Underway
dominionOfRempahConvoy-route-2-variant-1.description: A path through the Open Seas has presented itself, through DMC territory. The Kota Lama traders have prepared holds brimming with goods. They have left for the long voyage south.

dominionOfRempahConvoy-route-2-variant-2.name: Departing Soon
dominionOfRempahConvoy-route-2-variant-2.description: A path through the Open Seas has presented itself, through DMC territory. The Kota Lama traders have prepared holds brimming with goods. They aim to leave soon for a long voyage south.

shadowLegionConvoy-route-1-variant-1.name: Underway
shadowLegionConvoy-route-1-variant-1.description: Sailors speak of a lost convoy that once carried a motherlode of wine and spirits. Now, there are whispers of ships flying the same faded colors as before, headed north of the Open Seas.

shadowLegionConvoy-route-1-variant-2.name: Departing Soon
shadowLegionConvoy-route-1-variant-2.description: Sailors speak of a lost convoy that once carried a motherlode of wine and spirits. Now, there are whispers of ships flying the same faded colors as before, massing south of the Open Seas.

shadowLegionConvoy-route-2-variant-1.name: Underway
shadowLegionConvoy-route-2-variant-1.description: Years ago, a fleet was sunk after a battle with a Megafort. The same ships have been spotted again, headed south, possibly for vengeance.

shadowLegionConvoy-route-2-variant-2.name: Departing Soon
shadowLegionConvoy-route-2-variant-2.description: Years ago, a fleet was sunk after a battle with a Megafort. The same ships have been spotted again, set to head south, possibly for vengeance.

clanOfFaraConvoy-route-1-variant-1.name: Underway
clanOfFaraConvoy-route-1-variant-1.description: The Fara are eager to carve out new trade routes to India. Their merchants have set sail from Sitrana.

clanOfFaraConvoy-route-1-variant-2.name: Departing Soon
clanOfFaraConvoy-route-1-variant-2.description: The Fara are eager to carve out new trade routes to India. Their merchants will soon set sail from Sitrana.

clanOfFaraConvoy-route-2-variant-1.name: Underway
clanOfFaraConvoy-route-2-variant-1.description: The suffocation of trade in the Red Isle by the Compagnie has forced Fara merchants to set sail, searching for traders about the southern tip of Africa.

clanOfFaraConvoy-route-2-variant-2.name: Departing Soon
clanOfFaraConvoy-route-2-variant-2.description: The suffocation of trade in the Red Isle by the Compagnie will soon force Fara merchants to set sail, searching for traders about the southern tip of Africa.

compagnieRoyaleConvoy-route-1-variant-1.name: Underway
compagnieRoyaleConvoy-route-1-variant-1.description: Compagnie soldiers need wine and brandy to boost morale. A convoy has left the Red Isle, carrying spirits.

compagnieRoyaleConvoy-route-1-variant-2.name: Departing Soon
compagnieRoyaleConvoy-route-1-variant-2.description: Compagnie soldiers need wine and brandy to boost morale. A convoy is set to leave the Red Isle, carrying spirits.

compagnieRoyaleConvoy-route-2-variant-1.name: Underway
compagnieRoyaleConvoy-route-2-variant-1.description: A convoy from the Compagnie has set sail with spoils from the East Indies. Passing by Port Louis, it aims to sail southward of the Indian Ocean.

compagnieRoyaleConvoy-route-2-variant-2.name: Departing Soon
compagnieRoyaleConvoy-route-2-variant-2.description: A convoy from the Compagnie will soon ship back its spoils from the East Indies. Passing by Port Louis, it aims to sail southward of the Indian Ocean.

royalWarConvoy.name: ROYAL WAR CONVOY
royalWarConvoy.description: As the war effort continues, assets are transported to key Compagnie territories to combat the rising Dutch invasion.

chorusFleetConvoy-route-1-variant-1.name: Underway
chorusFleetConvoy-route-1-variant-1.description: The alliance with the Fara has been lucrative for the Compagnie. A convoy under the protection of the Chorus Fleet and carrying profitable trade goods has set sail from Hovohovo.

chorusFleetConvoy-route-1-variant-2.name: Departing Soon
chorusFleetConvoy-route-1-variant-2.description: The alliance with the Fara has been lucrative for the Compagnie. A convoy under the protection of the Chorus Fleet and carrying profitable trade goods will soon set sail from Hovohovo.

chorusFleetConvoy-route-2-variant-1.name: Underway
chorusFleetConvoy-route-2-variant-1.description: A Compagnie convoy, under the protection of the Chorus Fleet, has begun transporting its spoils back to their homeland. Passing by Port Louis, it aims to sail south of the Indian Ocean.

chorusFleetConvoy-route-2-variant-2.name: Departing Soon
chorusFleetConvoy-route-2-variant-2.description: A Compagnie convoy, under the protection of the Chorus Fleet, will soon depart, transporting its spoils back to their homeland. Passing by Port Louis, it aims to sail south of the Indian Ocean.

confederationOfUngwanaConvoy-route-1-var.name: Underway
confederationOfUngwanaConvoy-route-1-var.description: A convoy has set sail from Bandari after Ungwanamerchants signed a deal with their neighbors toolucrative (and dangerous) to pass up.

confederationOfUngwanaConvoy-route-1-var.name: Departing Soon
confederationOfUngwanaConvoy-route-1-var.description: A convoy is set to sail from Bandari after Ungwana merchants signed a deal with their neighbors too lucrative (and dangerous) to pass up.

confederationOfUngwanaConvoy-route-2-var.name: Underway
confederationOfUngwanaConvoy-route-2-var.description: Illicit substances procured from the north of Africa have left from the port of Harifu, headed into the heart of the Coast. Ungwana merchants will profit from the trade, not caring if the poison cripples their people.

confederationOfUngwanaConvoy-route-2-var.name: Departing Soon
confederationOfUngwanaConvoy-route-2-var.description: Illicit substances procured from the north of Africa will soon leave from the port of Harifu, headed into the heart of the Coast. Ungwana merchants will profit from the trade, not caring if the poison cripples their people.

dmcConvoy-route-1-variant-1.name: Underway
dmcConvoy-route-1-variant-1.description: The DMC soldiers stationed in Lada did not believe the rumors of ghosts and ships floating on the waves... till it was too late. Now, the survivors flee southwards, still shaken from strange whispers in their dreams.

dmcConvoy-route-1-variant-2.name: Departing Soon
dmcConvoy-route-1-variant-2.description: The DMC soldiers stationed in Lada did not believe the rumors of ghosts and ships floating on the waves... till it was too late. The survivors aim to flee southwards, still shaken from strange whispers in their dreams.

dmcConvoy-route-2-variant-1.name: Underway
dmcConvoy-route-2-variant-1.description: DMC commanders have failed to push back Vikram's forces. They are now in flight, carrying supplies and what's left of their pride.

dmcConvoy-route-2-variant-2.name: Departing Soon
dmcConvoy-route-2-variant-2.description: DMC commanders have failed to push back Vikram's forces. They mean to flee, carrying supplies and what's left of their pride.

reapItWeep.name: REAP IT & WEEP
reapItWeep.description: Use Hallowed Flare at this event buoy to summon Unbound Reaper.

reaperOfTheLost.name: Reaper of the Lost
reaperOfTheLost.description: The veil between worlds has thinned and brought the Reaper of the Lost to the seas. Claim its riches before it slips away.
